_doc: News shown in game (newest first). id changes trigger the popup once.

news.title: 自動更新
news.body: 之後有新版本，遊戲會自動重新載入（打緊嗰陣會喺底部顯示「重新載入」掣，撳之前會自動存檔），唔會再出現公告講咗更新但畫面仲係舊版。
news.bodyEn: From now on the game reloads itself when a new version is out (during play a Reload button appears at the bottom; it autosaves first), so you won't be stuck on an old version after an update.

news.title: 大螢幕介面放大＋唔會再誤跳頁
news.titleEn: Bigger menus on large monitors + no more accidental page jumps
news.body: 電腦大螢幕上，技能珠、裝備等畫面會跟視窗大細一齊放大，唔會再好空。觸控板左右掃、滑鼠返回掣或者瀏覽器「返回」唔會再離開遊戲，打緊嗰陣會改為暫停。
news.bodyEn: On large monitors the orb, equipment and other menus now scale with the window instead of leaving lots of empty space. Touchpad swipes, the mouse back button or the browser Back button no longer leave the game; during a run they pause it.

news.title: 雲端自動同步＋技能珠畫面重新設計
news.titleEn: Cloud auto-sync + redesigned skill orb screen
news.body: 用 Google／Discord 登入（帳戶／雲端存檔）之後，存檔會自動上載，換機登入就可以下載返。技能珠同裝備而家分開兩個畫面（手機右上 ◆ 技能珠、⚔ 裝備）；技能珠背包可以按類型篩選。修正咗手機撳唔到「繼續」嘅問題。
news.bodyEn: After signing in with Google / Discord (Account / cloud saves), your saves upload automatically and you can download them on another device. Skill orbs and equipment are now separate screens (◆ orbs, ⚔ gear at the top right on phones), and the orb bag has type filters. Fixed the Continue button not responding to taps on phones.

news.title: 新手村改版＋手機全螢幕
news.body: 村入面而家有三個入口：右下「主線傳送門」揀區域（有圖示卡），「挑戰祭壇」玩每日／每週裂隙，「榮譽石碑」睇排行榜。右上新增 ⛶ 全螢幕掣；iPhone 可以「分享 → 加入主畫面」當 App 咁全螢幕玩。
news.bodyEn: The village now has three entrances: the Zone Portal (zone cards with icons), the Challenge Altar (daily / weekly rifts) and the Hall of Fame (leaderboard). New ⛶ fullscreen button at the top right; on iPhone use Share → Add to Home Screen to play fullscreen like an app.

news.title: 每日／每週裂隙排行榜上線
news.titleEn: Daily / weekly rift leaderboards are live
news.body: 通關每日或每週裂隙會自動上傳你最快嘅成績。喺傳送門或者選單撳「排行榜」睇全世界排名。
news.bodyEn: Clearing a daily or weekly rift uploads your fastest time automatically. Open Leaderboard from the portal or the menu to see the world ranking.

news.title: 每日／每週裂隙同活動系統上線
news.titleEn: Daily / weekly rifts and events are live
news.body: 喺傳送門揀「每日裂隙」或「每週裂隙」：全世界同一個種子同詞綴，第一次通關送金幣同傳奇，每日連續通關獎勵越嚟越多。開張慶典期間所有獎勵 +25%。
news.bodyEn: Pick Daily or Weekly Rift at the portal: same seed and modifiers for everyone; the first clear pays gold and a legendary, and daily streaks pay more. All rewards +25% during the celebration.
